Closing map: value added per person engaged, every state. Chosen as a news-pegged Short (MoSPI Volume I, 4 Nov 2026; the ranking itself is in the 30 Sep factsheet). alt_title: Tamil Nadu: Most Factories, 3rd in Value Added (ASI 2024-25)
description: Tamil Nadu has India's most factories and ranks third in gross value added (MoSPI, Annual Survey of Industries 2024-25).

Factories: Tamil Nadu 41,221 (15.44% of India's), Gujarat 33,084
Gross value added, share of India's: Tamil Nadu 10.90%, Maharashtra 15.92%, Gujarat 14.10%
Value added per person engaged: Maharashtra Rs 15.6 lakh, Tamil Nadu Rs 9.3 lakh, India Rs 12.8 lakh (our calculation)

Closing map: value added per person engaged, every state. Blank: Dadra and Nagar Haveli and Daman and Diu, Andaman and Nicobar Islands, Lakshadweep. Registered factories only. The table shows how much, not why.
source: Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation, Annual Survey of Industries 2024-25: factsheet (30 Sep 2026), Table 5, and Annexure II Table 3 'Principal Characteristics by Major States' (xlsx linked from the factsheet); Volume I and Summary Results released 4 Nov 2026 (PIB PRID 2332475). Registered factories and other covered units, not all manufacturing. Gross value added = net value added plus depreciation (reproduces the factsheet's shares). Persons engaged are everyone working in the factory, not only workers. Value added per person engaged is our calculation: Maharashtra Rs 15.62 lakh, Tamil Nadu Rs 9.33 lakh, India Rs 12.83 lakh. Tamil Nadu: 41,221 factories (15.44% of India's 266,931; Gujarat 33,084), 3,147,520 persons engaged (14.99%), 10.90% of GVA, third after Maharashtra 15.92% and Gujarat 14.10%.
